ticker.name: Morgan Stanley Emerging Markets Domestic Debt Fund, Inc.

business_summary: Morgan Stanley Emerging Markets Domestic Debt Fund, Inc. is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by Morgan Stanley Investment Management Inc. The fund invests in fixed income markets of emerging market countries across the globe. It typically invests in government bonds denominated in the local currencies of emerging markets. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the JPMorgan Government Bond Index - Emerging Markets Global Diversified Index. Morgan Stanley Emerging Markets Domestic Debt Fund, Inc. was formed on January 25, 2007 and is domiciled in United States.
business_summary_ko: Morgan Stanley Emerging Markets Domestic Debt Fund, Inc.는 Morgan Stanley Investment Management Inc.가 출시하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 채권 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 전 세계 신흥 시장 국가의 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 일반적으로 신흥시장의 현지 통화로 표시된 국채에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 JPMorgan Government Bond Index - Emerging Markets Global Diversified Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. Morgan Stanley Emerging Markets Domestic Debt Fund, Inc.는 2007년 1월 25일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
